title: A New, Rotating Hot Corino in Serpens
question: Does the Class 0 protostar Ser-emb 1 host a hot corino, and is hot corino emission connected to rotation (a possible protostellar disk)?

data.sensitivity: Channel rms 5-9 mJy/beam (robust 0.5, high-res windows), ~2 mJy/beam (low-res windows); 6-12 mJy/beam at robust 0.0

what.value: Spectroscopic line parameters for CH3OH, CH2DOH, CH3OCH3, CH3OCHO

evidence.quote: the values for CH$_3$OH, CH$_2$DOH, CH$_3$OCH$_3$, and CH$_3$OCHO used in Sect. [3.2.1](#sec:rot) are extracted from (cite: xu08), (cite: pearson12), (cite: endres09), and (cite: ilyushin09), respectively.

what.value: Envelope mass, disk mass (0.28 Msun), bolometric temperature (39 K), luminosity (4.1 Lsun) of Ser-emb 1

evidence.quote: Its remaining envelope mass is 3.1 $M_{\odot}$[^2], and the estimated disk mass is 0.28 $M_{\odot}$ (cite: enoch11).

what.value: Column densities of CH3OH, CH3OCH3, CH3OCHO and luminosities for other hot corinos (comparison table)

external_data.citation: (cite: taquet15); (cite: jorgensen18); (cite: jacobsen18); (cite: lopezsepulcre17); (cite: lee19); (cite: bottinelli07); (cite: imai16); (cite: marcelino18)

what.value: Partition function correction factor for higher torsional states of CH3OCHO

evidence.quote: to take into account the higher torsional states that are not included in the partition function extracted from the JPL catalog (cite: favre14).

recipe.method: Self-calibrate channel-averaged line-free continuum in 1-2 rounds, apply to native visibilities, subtract continuum in uv plane

recipe.goal: Image cubes and extract source spectrum
recipe.method: tclean with Briggs robust 0.5 and auto-mask; spectrum extracted at the continuum peak pixel
Assign lines above 4 sigma using JPL and CDMS catalogs; detection criteria based on number of lines/isotopologs or >10 sigma

recipe.goal: CH3OH rotational diagram and column densities
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to each CH3OH line (fixed VLSR 8.64, FWHM 3.33 km/s), rotational diagram linear fit, beam-dilution correction with filling factor ~7.5; Trot applied to CH2DOH, CH3OCH3, CH3OCHO
key_parameters: Source size <= (0.29±0.15)"x(0.12±0.10)" from 2D Gaussian fit of 10(-3)-11(-2) moment 0 map
assumptions: LTE, optically thin lines; column densities are lower limits; CH3OCHO corrected by factor 2.1 for torsional states

recipe.method: Re-image identified lines at robust 0.0 and make moment 0 maps; 2D Gaussian fit to size of methanol emission
High-velocity red/blue moment maps and PV diagrams perpendicular and parallel to the outflow, compared with Keplerian (v∝R^-0.5) and infalling-rotating (v∝R^-1) curves
assumptions: Outflow direction is rotation axis of potential disk

evidence.quote: the CH$_3$OH rotational temperature is 261 $\pm$ 46 K
These column densities imply a D/H ratio for methanol of 0.40
CH$_3$OCH$_3$/CH$_3$OH and CH$_3$OCHO/CH$_3$OH ratios of 0.77 and 0.76, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: Radius of high-velocity C18O rotating component

evidence.quote: Therefore, the actual radius of this compact component could be $<$200 au.

not_stated_but_needed: Which self-calibration solution intervals and reference spws were used
Image size and cell size for tclean
Region/aperture used for the 'central pixel' spectrum and for PV cuts (width)
Velocity ranges for the high/mid/low-velocity moment maps
Exact Gaussian-fit uncertainties approach for line fluxes and the filling-factor handling
Whether the data were reduced with CASA pipeline vs. archive products; flux scale uncertainty
missing_for_reproduction: PV cut widths and moment-map velocity limits
Flux uncertainties used in rotational diagram fit
score_reason: Public ALMA project and clear rotational-diagram recipe, but many imaging and self-cal parameters missing.
rediscovery_reason: Single public project, numeric results (Trot, column densities) derivable with a described recipe, although some settings are missing.
